name: 垂枝光纤街树

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. One four-unit tall cyberpunk street tree sculpture: dark silver slender trunk, gracefully arching branches and slightly drooping thick rose-magenta fiber sprays with occasional cyan tips, vertical narrow crown, open lower trunk, solid coherent geometry. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.
